## ⚠️ STOP: Do Not Disclose Security Flaws Publicly

If you have discovered a security vulnerability, privilege escalation, authorization bypass, or sensitive data leak in Saarthi, **please do not post the details in a public issue**.

Public disclosure puts civic data and platform users at risk.

### How to Report Responsibly:

1. **GitHub Private Security Advisory (Recommended):**
   Please navigate to [Report a Vulnerability](https://github.com/404Vardan/saarthi-welfare-intelligence/security/advisories/new) to submit your report confidentially to the maintainers.

2. **Email the Maintainer Directly:**
   Send an encrypted or private email to:
   - **Contact**: `pinkudesai1301@gmail.com`
   - **Subject**: `[SECURITY] Saarthi Vulnerability Report`

Please consult our comprehensive [Security Policy](https://github.com/404Vardan/saarthi-welfare-intelligence/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for vulnerability handling timelines and architectural details.

Thank you for helping keep Saarthi safe and secure.
